The darkest values are mapped to the characters in the bottom left corner and the brightest values to the character in the top right corner. The existing presets are in 128x128 resolution, but any resolution will work, as long as it's square, but different resolutions will react differently to the "Scale"-value of the effect. To create an atlas, you can use a free browser-based tool called "font2bitmap", hosted on itch.io at: "https://stmn.itch.io/font2bitmap". Then download the file and insert it into the compositor using an "image"-node. You don't need to add a "Scale"-node yourself, as there is already one built-in inside this node-group.
